## Task 1: Does including header text improve prediction?

To assess whether header information improves classification performance, I extended
the HTML parser to include headers in addition to paragraph text. I evaluated
performance on a 70/30 train–test split using PCR. The paragraph-only model 
achieved a test accuracy of about **0.671**, while the header-augmented model 
achieved only about **0.594**. This tells us that headers do not provide useful
additional signal for this task and likely introduce unnecessary noise.
